## [1.2.0](https://github.com/riky-dev/morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0) (2026-08-28)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **capcut:** tolerate obfuscated HeliosEnvImpl init parameter ([42cd0e3](https://github.com/riky-dev/morphe-patches/commit/42cd0e341cf1ef8257fab693776e617ffdcc58ac)), closes [#7](https://github.com/riky-dev/morphe-patches/issues/7) [#9](https://github.com/riky-dev/morphe-patches/issues/9)

### ✨ New Features

* add agent patch workflow framework ([a5a7520](https://github.com/riky-dev/morphe-patches/commit/a5a75206f04f6ba41d6be30d8804cd8ee54303e1))

patches.name: Hide AI Lab Tab
patches.description: Removes the third bottom navigation tab ('AI Lab' / 'Lab. IA') by forcing its visibility observer to always hide the tab.

patches.name: Hide False Hopes Features
patches.description: Hides 'IA ultra HD' (Export Super Resolution) and 'Flusso ottico' (Slow Motion Optical Flow) options since they are cloud-gated.

patches.name: Remove security notice
patches.description: Suppresses the modified-build security notice by disabling the risk SDK dialog entry point and the isCracking flag writer.

patches.name: Suppress Telemetry and Trackers
patches.description: Disables background monitoring and analytics frameworks including ByteDance Helios, AppLog, and AppsFlyer.

patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Forces the VIP flag to true so premium features are unlocked client-side. Server-validated assets (cloud effects/templates) are not affected.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Spoofs premium/unlocked state to disable ad-gated behavior.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Removes banner, native, cover and interstitial ads and unlocks premium features.

patches.name: Unlock map regions
patches.description: Spoof Komoot Maps ownership client-side (world pack / owned regions in shop and offline UI). Server-side limits may still apply: offline tile download auth, sync overwriting local state, and Play receipt validation. Does not replace a real Play Store purchase.

patches.name: Unlock Premium features
patches.description: Unlock Premium features. Some features are not possible to patch (server sided), such as saving a multi-days hike.
